drafts.platform:
To: Grievance Officer, Instagram
Subject: Removal of non-consensual synthetically altered image, Kavach case demo-case

I am Priya. A manipulated image of me is being circulated on Instagram. I first saw it on 2026-10-23.
URL of the content: https://instagram.com/p/C7xk2demo
SHA-256 of the image as received: 02481da775fb97f1a0f822af13b6db1eff38acf1bb2ba288890d209ef59d9aa7

Perceptual fingerprint comparison shows the image was made from my own photograph, registered with Kavach on 2026-10-12, with 90% similarity (methods: cloudinary-phash, face-phash, face-dhash). The image was altered without my consent.

Under Rule 3(2)(b) of the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, as amended on 10 February 2026 and in force from 20 February 2026, you are required to remove or disable access to non-consensual synthetically generated or altered intimate and morphed imagery within 2 hours of receiving this complaint. This is punishable under Section 66E (violation of privacy) and Section 67 (publishing obscene material) of the Information Technology Act, 2000, and under Section 351 (criminal intimidation) and Section 356 (defamation) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.

I request that you:
1. Remove the content and all copies within 2 hours of this complaint.
2. Preserve the uploader's account details, IP logs and upload metadata for law enforcement.
3. Confirm the action taken in writing to me, with a reference number.

A Kavach evidence record (fingerprint comparison, hashes and timestamps) is available on request and has been attached to my complaint on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal.

Priya
Date: 2026-10-23

Verify section numbers with the portal or a lawyer before filing.
